name: snowman
description: Read-only Snowflake exploration through the snow CLI: schema discovery, profiling, hypothesis testing, and data-quality investigation. A guardrail wrapper rejects anything but a single read-only statement, returns CSV capped at 50 rows and 200 chars per cell, and saves an overflowing result in full. When the user asks for a change, the wrapper stages the DML or DDL as a script for the user to run. It never executes writes. Bootstraps a committed per-project context.
